ambiguity_notes: The record onset was probably set from the Day +4 tremor (A18/A24). ReSauce judges only by what the documents show on that date and does not guess the reason. Without the Day +4 ICE 10/10 this onset would be 7.4. Tocilizumab and dexamethasone are treatment (A35).
